fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
The Tasks folder in system32 and syswow64 are globally writable paths.
Adversaries can take advantage of this and load or influence any script hosts or ANY .NET Application
in Tasks to load and execute a custom assembly into cscript, wscript, regsvr32, mshta, eventvwr
fields.name: Tasks Folder Evasion
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "echo " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "copy " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "type " or tgt.process.cmdline contains "file createnew") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " C:\\Windows\\System32\\Tasks\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " C:\\Windows\\SysWow64\\Tasks\\")))
